title: Finite Galois descent equalizer for a sheaf
statement: Let L/K be a finite Galois extension with group H, let F be a sheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] of sets or abelian groups on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] of Spec K, and write p1,p2:Spec(L \otimes_K L) \to Spec L for the two projections. The canonical decomposition L \otimes_K L = product_{h in H} L identifies the equalizer of F(Spec L) with the two pullbacks p1^*,p2^* with the H-invariant subset F(Spec L)^H; equivalently, every H-invariant section over Spec L descends uniquely to Spec K.
